transformation.en: The digital transformation of public administration has reshaped how agencies deliver services to citizens.
transformation.zh: 公共管理的数字化转型重塑了政府机构向公众提供服务的路径。

transformation.en: Economic transformation in the region was driven by the relocation of manufacturing industries.
transformation.zh: 该地区的经济转型由制造业向低成本地区转移所推动。

transformation.en: Transformation of the existing curriculum requires sustained investment in teacher training and digital infrastructure.
transformation.zh: 现有课程的改造需要在教师培训与数字基础设施方面持续投入。

transmission.en: Transmission of the virus through airborne droplets remains the primary concern in epidemiological models.
transmission.zh: 病毒通过飞沫传播仍是流行病学模型中的首要关切。

transmission.en: The transmission of knowledge between research groups depends on sustained informal communication channels.
transmission.zh: 研究群体之间知识的传递依赖持续的日常沟通渠道。

transmission.en: Improved insulation substantially reduces heat transmission through the building envelope.
transmission.zh: 改进后的隔热措施显著减少了热量通过建筑围护结构的传递。

typology.en: The proposed typology distinguishes institutional from individual forms of political participation.
typology.zh: 所提出的类型学区分了制度性与个体性的政治参与形式。

typology.en: Such a typology assumes that all economies can be classified along a single continuum.
typology.zh: 这种类型划分假定所有经济体都可以沿单一的连续谱加以归类。

typology.en: Later revisions to the typology incorporated evidence from additional regional case studies.
typology.zh: 该类型学后来的修订纳入了更多区域性个案研究所提供的证据。

utilization.en: Utilization of satellite imagery has improved the accuracy of land cover classification.
utilization.zh: 卫星影像的利用提高了土地覆被分类的准确度。

utilization.en: The utilization of existing infrastructure reduces the environmental cost of urban expansion.
utilization.zh: 对既有基础设施的利用可以降低城市扩张的环境代价。

utilization.en: Hospital utilization data revealed substantial geographic disparities in access to primary care.
utilization.zh: 医院服务利用率数据揭示了初级卫生服务可及性方面的显著地域差距。

variability.en: Variability in rainfall across successive seasons complicates the calibration of crop yield models.
variability.zh: 各季降水量的波动性使作物产量模型的校准更为困难。

variability.en: Interindividual variability in treatment response was smaller than the authors had anticipated.
variability.zh: 个体间在治疗反应上的变异性小于作者原先的预期。

variability.en: Greater variability in measured outcomes prompted investigators to reconsider the sampling frame.
variability.zh: 测量结果的更大波动促使研究者重新审视抽样框的设计。

variation.en: Variation in the recorded data largely reflects differences in laboratory procedure rather than genuine change.
variation.zh: 所记录数据的差异在很大程度上反映了实验室程序的不同，而非真实变化。

variation.en: Genetic variation within the population explains part of the observed phenotypic difference.
variation.zh: 群体内部的遗传变异解释了表型差异的一部分。

variation.en: The new document records seasonal variation in water demand across the district.
variation.zh: 新文件记录了该地区水需求随季节的变化情况。

viability.en: The viability of the proposal depends on securing stable long-term funding.
viability.zh: 该方案的可行性取决于能否获得稳定的长期资金支持。

viability.en: Field trials were required to establish the viability of the treatment under local conditions.
viability.zh: 为确立该疗法在本地条件下的可行性，有必要开展田间试验。

viability.en: Researchers doubt the commercial viability of the technology without sustained government support.
viability.zh: 缺乏持续的政府支持，研究者对该技术的商业可行性持怀疑态度。

vitality.en: The vitality of the local economy depends on the continued competitiveness of manufacturing exports.
vitality.zh: 当地经济活力取决于制造业出口能否保持持续竞争力。

vitality.en: Ageing populations threaten the vitality of rural communities in many regions.
vitality.zh: 人口老龄化威胁着许多地区农村社区的活力。

vitality.en: The vitality of a theory lies in its capacity to generate new empirical questions.
vitality.zh: 一个理论的生命力在于其提出新的经验问题的能力。

volatility.en: Price volatility in agricultural commodities reduces the willingness of producers to adopt new crops.
volatility.zh: 农产品价格的高波动性降低了生产者采用新作物的意愿。

volatility.en: Volatility in the exchange rate complicates the assessment of international competitiveness.
volatility.zh: 汇率的频繁波动使国际竞争力的评估变得复杂。

volatility.en: Political volatility has discouraged private investors from committing capital to the sector.
volatility.zh: 政治动荡已使私人投资者不愿向该部门投入资本。

welfare.en: The welfare of rural households depends on access to transport and public health services.
welfare.zh: 农村家庭的福祉取决于能否获得交通与公共卫生服务。

welfare.en: Policy reform should not pursue economic growth at the expense of social welfare.
welfare.zh: 政策改革不应以牺牲社会福利为代价追求经济增长。

welfare.en: Welfare agencies reported an increase in referrals during the winter months.
welfare.zh: 福利机构报告称冬季转介数量有所增加。

accessible.en: Remote rural areas remain poorly accessible to specialist medical services.
accessible.zh: 偏远农村地区仍难以获得专科医疗服务。

accessible.en: The museum has made its collections accessible online for researchers worldwide.
accessible.zh: 该博物馆已将其馆藏在线开放，供全球研究者使用。

accessible.en: Accessible design principles ensure that the interface remains usable for users with disabilities.
accessible.zh: 无障碍设计原则确保界面对残障用户依然可用。

accountable.en: Public agencies must remain accountable for the environmental consequences of their decisions.
accountable.zh: 公共机构必须对其决策带来的环境后果负责。

accountable.en: The new framework holds each ministry accountable for the outcomes it has committed to deliver.
accountable.zh: 新框架使各部委对其承诺交付的成果负有问责义务。

accountable.en: Without transparent reporting mechanisms, elected officials cannot be held accountable for spending decisions.
accountable.zh: 若缺乏透明的报告机制，就无法追究民选官员在支出决策上的责任。

apparent.en: The apparent decline in the disease was partly attributable to changes in reporting practice.
apparent.zh: 该疾病表面上的下降部分可归因于报告实务的变化。

apparent.en: An apparent correlation between two variables does not establish a causal relationship.
apparent.zh: 两个变量之间的表面相关并不能确立因果关系。

apparent.en: The committee questioned the apparent consensus among reviewers on the proposed reform.
apparent.zh: 委员会对评审者之间就拟议改革表现出的表面共识提出质疑。
